When you clean a room, don't try to do it all at once. Grab your phone and set an alarm, 45 minutes is usually a long enough time to get into the groove without getting too tired. Then, put on some music you like, an audio book, etc. (I like to put on stand-up shows); try to keep it to audio, as visuals like TV can be distracting.

Then you can jump or ease into it. Once the timer ends, you may find that you want to keep organizing. It's OK to finish up what you were doing, or do that thing you wanted to do before you forgot, but then stop. It is important that you don't burn out, because this may dis-incentivize you to clean again.
